description: Relays the signed approveAgent to Hyperliquid. On hyperliquid_refused, reason no_deposit means deposit USDC first; too_many_agents means revoke an API wallet on Hyperliquid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key (1 to 255 printable ASCII characters, for example a UUID): retrying with the same key and arguments within 24 hours returns the first answer and runs nothing again.

signature.description: EIP-712 signature split into r, s, v (v = 27 or 28)

name: submit_trading_key
title: Submit the signed trading key approval
